g.text: Q120/Q121 AON6403 back-to-back: load switch + reverse-battery block + no back-feed from RAW_ACT.

g.desc: Q120/Q121 AON6403 back-to-back: load switch + reverse-battery block + no back-feed from RAW_ACT.

g.text: Q122 turns the pair on only while RAW_PROTECTED is up, i.e. it follows the single J1.3-J1.4 switch and U9 fault latch.

g.desc: Q122 turns the pair on only while RAW_PROTECTED is up, i.e. it follows the single J1.3-J1.4 switch and U9 fault latch.

g.text: USB alone: RAW_PROTECTED = 0, so RAW_ACT, the servo header and the ARM terminal are dead.

g.desc: USB alone: RAW_PROTECTED = 0, so RAW_ACT, the servo header and the ARM terminal are dead.

g.text: C120 is gate-SOURCE (P0-4): a shorted C120 fails OFF. ~150 ms ride-through of contact bounce (inference, X5R bias).

g.desc: C120 is gate-SOURCE (P0-4): a shorted C120 fails OFF. ~150 ms ride-through of contact bounce (inference, X5R bias).

g.text: R124/R125 10k/4.7k -> PB0: RAW_ACT sense AND bleed (tau ~7 s with C121). Mandatory external 15 A ATO fuse in battery lead.

g.desc: R124/R125 10k/4.7k -> PB0: RAW_ACT sense AND bleed (tau ~7 s with C121). Mandatory external 15 A ATO fuse in battery lead.

g.text: Second, high-current battery path for servos and pyro. U9 (sheet 07) is NOT sized for actuator current.
